effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[End of Your Turn] If you have 6 or fewer cards in your hand, by placing this Tamer as the bottom digivolution card of any of your Digimon with [Belphemon] in their names, that Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Belphemon] in its name in the trash without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
